places.name: Blanco River
places.note: Where a bungling horsethief once rustled stock before Augustus and Call caught and hanged him some twelve years back.
places.location_hint: Blanco River country of central Texas, Hill Country west of Austin

places.name: Llano Estacado
places.note: By the second day Augustus judges Blue Duck is heading for this vast tableland.

places.name: Palo Duro Canyon
places.note: Blue Duck used to retreat beyond it; Augustus recalls giving up a waterless chase there with Call, then rides to its edge now.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Augustus once warned Call that killing their horses on the plains would mean a long walk back there.

places.raw_name: the Clear Fork of the Brazos
places.name: Clear Fork Brazos River
places.note: Augustus crosses it and passes an abandoned half-built cabin, a reminder of settlers driven off by Comanche raids.

places.name: Brazos River
places.note: Augustus camps cold on a bluff in the post-oak country near it; years ago he and Call shot it out with Aus Frank in a thicket there.

places.name: Trinity River
places.note: Frontier settlers came up it and the Brazos in the Fifties, only to retreat from Comanche terror.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Augustus misses its familiar noises in the silent plains; the partners once doubted buffalo-slaughter reports there.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Wichita River
places.note: After finding Lorena's dead mare and leaving the scrub, Augustus crosses it and bears west.
places.location_hint: north Texas, south of the Red River

places.name: Adobe Walls
places.note: Abandoned Bent trading post on the Canadian where buffalo hunters gather; Augustus suspects Blue Duck took Lorena there and heads for it.
places.location_hint: on the Canadian River in the Texas Panhandle

places.name: Canadian River
places.note: Augustus finds old Aus Frank piling huge pyramids of buffalo bones beside it, spends the night, then rides east along it.

places.raw_name: the big crossing on the Canadian
places.name: Comanche captive crossing on the Canadian
places.note: Old Comanche captive-trading crossing; Augustus inspects it, finding many horse tracks but not Blue Duck's.
places.location_hint: on the Canadian River in the Texas Panhandle, north of the Quitaque and west of Adobe Walls; a mile downriver from Aus Frank's bone camp

places.name: Valley of Tears
places.note: Notorious spot near the captive crossing where Comancheros split up captive mothers and children for sale.
places.location_hint: near the Comanche trading crossing on the Canadian River, Texas Panhandle

places.name: Quitaque
places.note: Parched country of shallow red canyons, dust devils and mirages that Augustus rides through toward the Palo Duro.
places.location_hint: Texas Panhandle, southeast of Palo Duro Canyon

places.raw_name: the Prairie Dog Fork of the Red River
places.name: Prairie Dog Town Fork Red River
places.note: Augustus crosses it amid many prairie dogs on his way west.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Talk there held that the raiding bands were scattered, which Augustus now doubts.

places.name: Waco
places.note: Aus Frank kept a store there, robbed the bank beside it, was caught by Augustus and Call, and broke jail.

places.name: Pecos River
places.note: Aus Frank says Apaches from over that way stole his wagon.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Augustus asks the ex-trapper whether he reached it; no answer.

places.name: High Plains
places.note: Empty, buffalo-stripped plains with a road of bones; Augustus recalls once riding beside the vast southern herd here.

groups.label: Augustus searching for Lorena
groups.hint: riding east along the Canadian at dawn from Aus Frank's bone camp toward Adobe Walls

groups.label: Aus Frank
groups.hint: bone camp in a bluff cave south of the river, a mile above the old captive crossing
